label: D2 arrival at S1, gated by late-episode time / recent rare transition
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 when the reached state is S1 (D2 & state==1 has recall 0.999 and mass recall 1.0; it never fires at GO, essentially never at D1, and never on S2). Only about 31% of S1 arrivals activate it, and which ones depends on slow context. The rate climbs steeply late in the episode (trials 80-99: 10-15% of all steps, versus 2-3% mid-episode) and is also high in the first few trials. Mid-episode it fires mainly on common a1->S1 arrivals that follow a rare-transition trial. Magnitude is largest late in the episode and when value is low (the lowest value bin holds 47% of the mass). The top windows are a1->S1 common arrivals in the +1 trial after a rare-rewarded core. Recorded predicate: D2 & S1 & (ep_trial>=75 | ep_trial<10 | (a1 & previous trial rare)). Dev F1 0.70, mass recall 0.91. The bare D2 & S1 predicate has F1 0.47. All variables are observed at D2 (episode time can be tracked through the slow hidden state). It looks like an S1-arrival detector whose gain is set by an episode-time / value context.
